svg.title: Age of Renaissance: a contiguous, colored map of Iberia and northwest Africa
svg.desc: A static visual proposal with thirteen fully labeled provinces, touching land polygons, commodity colors, coastal routes, sea access codes, area boundaries, satellite arrows, market values and illustrative pieces. All connections involving the thirteen provinces are shown, including named continuations outside the crop. Province boundaries are schematic. Northern French context is deliberately incomplete. West Africa is a labeled distant-coast inset. Exact values and connections follow the repository catalogs.
svg.text: Contiguous provinces · all values visible · all coastal links and satellite arrows shown

g.text: N O R T H A F R I C A

svg.text: Both areas are available with 3+ players.
A corner contact does not create a border.
All links are visible; no selection required.
Sharing a sea is not a coastal step.
Access: none, except the West Africa inset.
Player pieces have their own row
Player identity is always written as well.
No gutters between provinces. Shared borders carry land adjacency; blue routes carry coastal adjacency.
The crop includes every land and coastal link touching the 13 labeled provinces, and every incoming or outgoing support arrow.
Toulouse, Montpellier and Tunis are named continuations. Their remaining connections lie outside this study.
Catalog facts: docs/province-inventory.md and docs/connection-inventory.md. Shapes are schematic; piece positions are examples.
